body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/33268

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/2299

Candidate PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2203

Independent review PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2265

## What changed

This correction preserves the candidate at exact reviewed commit `8665dbfc8eac3fd74113ba2365e7409ce80f1c44`, including its valid file, hf3fs, Mooncake, NIXL, EIC, UMBP, and logical dtype propagation fixes.

I independently reproduced the remaining Aibrix counterexample before changing code. `AibrixKVCacheStorage` accepted `HiCacheStorageConfig.kv_cache_dtype` but passed caller page keys unchanged to every `BlockHashes` construction. With a shared native `torch.float8_e4m3fnuz` storage dtype, logical `fp8_e4m3` and `fp8_e5m2` configurations therefore produced identical hash inputs.

The correction scopes Aibrix keys by the logical configured KV cache dtype before `acquire`, `allocate_for`/`put`, and `exists`. A missing dtype retains the legacy unscoped input. A registered stub-client regression exercises the client boundary without requiring the unavailable Aibrix package or service.

## Failing before / passing after

At exact candidate commit `8665dbfc8eac3fd74113ba2365e7409ce80f1c44`:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-2fcb53cc45eb/venv/bin/python \
  /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-2fcb53cc45eb/adversarial_aibrix.py
# e4m3: (('same_page',), 64)
# e5m2: (('same_page',), 64)
# AssertionError: AIBrix key collision across logical FP8 formats
# exit 1
```

After this correction, the same harness reports `dtype_fp8_e4m3_same_page` and `dtype_fp8_e5m2_same_page` and exits 0.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-2fcb53cc45eb/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_aibrix_kv_cache_dtype_key.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_hicache_kv_cache_dtype_key.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_mem_pool_host.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_mooncake_tenant_config.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_umbp_store.py
# 62 passed
```

## Limitations

The environment has no Aibrix, FlexKV, or LMCache package/service. Aibrix key construction was validated through a stubbed client boundary, not end to end. FlexKV and LMCache external key derivation remains unverified.

NPU memcache and SiMM source still derives component keys without the new dtype field, but their required architectures/services were unavailable. I did not treat that absence as evidence for a speculative source change. No model weights, serving run, multi-node workload, or GPU execution was used or claimed. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.

Full commands, raw outputs, and structured claims are retained under `reports/j-2fcb53cc45eb/`.
